title: Identifiers
description: Shared identifier formats used by every Virealm protocol message.

ProtocolVersion.description: Wire protocol version. Mirrors PROTOCOL_VERSION in virealm-process-runtime.

EnvironmentId.description: Opaque environment identifier. Non-empty, at most 128 characters, no control characters.

RequestId.description: Correlates a response with the request that produced it.

ProcessInstanceId.description: Durable process identity formatted as '<pid>:<creationTime100ns>'. A bare PID is never an identity because Windows reuses PIDs.
